summary: Every audio file that ships is accounted for here. Synthesised files are generated from arithmetic and are ours outright. Licensed files are third-party work and each one records where it came from, under what licence, and the credit line it obliges us to show. tools/audio/check-audio-provenance.mjs fails the build on any file that is in neither list.

generator.dependencies: none beyond the Node standard library
generator.note: The check regenerates in memory and byte-compares. A file that does not match the generator did not come from it, which is the whole point of the gate.

synthesised.description: Struck-bar tones on a C major pentatonic scale from C5 to E6, one step per consecutive find. Sine fundamental plus a quiet fourth harmonic under an exponential decay.
A short, dull A3. Deliberately quiet and low: a wrong tap should read as 'not here', not as punishment.
A C major triad with the octave (C5 E5 G5 C6) on a long decay, played when the board resolves.

acceptedLicences.note: Public domain dedication. Nothing to show, nothing to track.
Credit must be reachable from the app. The credits screen is generated from this file so a new track cannot ship uncredited.
Paid per-track licence from incompetech.com that removes the CC-BY credit obligation. Keep the receipt with the entry.

Permitted, but discouraged as a primary source: Pixabay is an open upload platform, so provenance is weaker than a single-author catalogue. If used, keep the download URL and a dated copy of the licence summary.

openItems: Only one track per mood. A second RELAX track would help before a player hears the first one for the hundredth time, but three is enough to ship.
